id: title:Gilbert09:promote recharge and gorgias to ga

This is a configuration or metadata update rather than a substantive implementation, test, or behavior correction. While it indicates availability, the lack of implementation or test changes prevents assigning a tier of 2 or higher. The score is assigned conservatively as 1, noting:
